slides.title: Chat feels like the playground
slides.text: Chatting in a game can feel like the playground, full of friends and jokes. But a screen hides who is really typing, so chat needs its own safety rules.
slides.alt: A game chat from Mia from Class: “Great game! Your tower at the end was amazing. See you at school.”

focus.cue: Game chat: friendly words after a game

slides.title: People you know in real life
slides.text: Safe chat is for people you know in real life: family, classmates and friends you have met face to face. A friendly stranger online is still a stranger.
slides.alt: Mia from Class: “Great game! Your tower at the end was amazing.” The debrief: that is the move, safe to deliver.

focus.cue: From Mia, a classmate you know
Safe: someone you know in real life

slides.title: Never move to a private chat
slides.text: A safe player never moves to a private chat because someone asks. That request is a warning sign, and so is any chat that must stay secret from trusted adults.
slides.alt: A game chat from CoolGamer99 with both clues marked: keep our chats from your parents, and a place to get together, the park gate.

focus.cue: A chat that must stay secret from adults
A stranger who wants to meet

slides.title: Spot the warning signs
slides.text: A new player in your game chat is very friendly, then asks two things. A Defender reads the signs before answering.
steps: A gift from a stranger: a rare skin, free
Then a secret: keep this our secret
Leave the chat and tell a trusted adult
slides.alt: A game chat from NewFriend with clues marked: “I can send you a rare game skin, free” and “keep this our secret.”

focus.cue: First a gift: a rare skin, free
Then a secret: keep this our secret

slides.title: Leaving is a lock
slides.text: You may leave any chat at any time, for any reason. Blocking someone who worries you is not rude. Blocking is a lock, and locks are what Defenders do.
slides.alt: The moves for NewFriend's chat: Deliver, Bin it, Show Pim, Report & block.

focus.cue: Report and block is always allowed

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Trick Inbox at Chat Careful and sort all 6 chat messages. For each one, ask: do I know this person in real life?
slides.alt: The debrief: chat is for people you know in real life. Behind this one: the key-hunter, who wants into your mailbox.

focus.cue: Play Chat Careful: do you know them in real life?
